models.name: RCSB
models.sampling_note: 500-aa target bin: 79 sequences of length 500, 11 of 499, 10 of 501; other target lengths exact.

control_policy: Native and Ctrl rows participate in sorting and display Ctrl instead of a numeric rank. Native rows participate in best-metric comparisons; other Ctrl rows do not.

score_metric.label: Score
score_metric.formula: 100 * count(plddt > 70 and ptm > 0.5 and repeat < 0.1) / count(all sequences)

aggregation: Score is the percentage of all sequences jointly satisfying pLDDT > 70, pTM > 0.5 and Repeat < 10%. pAE is not evaluated. pLDDT, pTM and PPL are arithmetic means over all sequences. Repetition metrics are mean per-sequence fractions multiplied by 100; no length-specific metric columns.

folding_protocol.source: Top-level JSONL scores. See each model folding_engine; ESMFold2-Fast sources do not specify the detailed folding configuration.

diversity_protocol.population: All sequences within each model and target-length bin; no quality filter
diversity_protocol.formula: mean over target-length bins of (100 * cluster_count_bin / sequence_count_bin)
diversity_protocol.aggregation: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of five length-bin percentages
diversity_protocol.binning: target_length when present, otherwise sequence length; RCSB 499/501 are assigned to target 500

repetition_protocol.repeat: Fraction of residues covered by contiguous motifs of length 1–20 repeated at least 3 times; overlapping regions are merged.
repetition_protocol.repn: 1 - unique n-grams / (L - n + 1), with 0 for L <= n; n = 2 or 5.

length_views.aggregation: Metrics computed within each target-length bin. Overall retains all-record means; Diversity is the equal-weight mean of per-length cluster ratios.
